author: Bobby Grayson
description:
Testing revealed some terminals/environments fail when receiving OSC 8 sequences. Prudent to disable by default initially.

Sources:
- 8b766a2: 'As a result of discussion in #2611, it seems prudent to disable hyperlinks by default. Ideally they would be enabled, but it looks like some environments may barf on them.'
title: Some environments break with hyperlink escape codes
